Vous allez montrer des données confident: You are about to show confidential data (figures, contracts, secrets). The NDA frames that sharing. In practice, many funds refuse to sign an NDA at the very start: this is common and not necessarily a bad sign. Save strong confidentiality for the data room and for genuinely sensitive information.
